examples.quote: Both founder density and reproductive threshold changed the food-dependent mixture pattern in this matched experiment. At the original threshold of 120, increasing the founder count weakened the food effect. At 48 founders, lowering the threshold from 120 to 80 weakened it even more. The effects of the two factors were not simply additive: each factor's effect depended on the setting of the other.
